nodes.description: Private owner address of BabyBNB, set to msg.sender in the constructor and used as the only authorization anchor in ensure, _mints, init, batchSend, delegate and setTradeAddress.
Public mapping(address => uint) holding token balances; mutated in transferFrom, _mints, batchSend and the constructor.
Public nested mapping(address => mapping(address => uint)) of spending approvals; written in approve/transferFrom and read in transferFrom.
Private mapping(address => uint256) counting how many sale transfers an address has performed; incremented in transferFrom and checked in condition.
Private mapping(address => bool) whitelist of addresses allowed to sell/transfer; set true in _mints and read in ensure.
Private minimum sale amount, configured by init and enforced in condition.
Private maximum sale amount, configured by init and enforced in condition.
Private maximum number of sales per address, configured by init and enforced in condition.
Address of an additional whitelisted trading contract, set by setTradeAddress and consulted in ensure.
Public total token supply, set once in the constructor.
Public constant decimals = 18, used in scaling arithmetic in _mints and init.
Constant Uniswap V2 router address 0x7a250d...488D, implicitly approved in the constructor.
Public token name set in the constructor.
Public token symbol set in the constructor.
Public payable transfer that simply forwards to transferFrom(msg.sender, _to, _value).
Public payable transfer path performing allowance deduction, ensure() gate, balance updates and _onSaleNum increment with unchecked arithmetic.
Internal view gate that whitelists owner, the Uniswap pair, tradeAddress and canSale addresses, otherwise enforcing condition().
Internal view sale-limits check against _saleNum, _minSale, _maxSale and _onSaleNum.
Public payable approval that writes allowance[msg.sender][_spender] without any zero-allowance protection.
Owner-only arbitrary delegatecall wrapper taking an address and calldata.
Privileged minting/whitelisting function restricted by a hard-coded list of msg.sender addresses; overwrites balanceOf[spender] and sets canSale.
Owner-only initializer of _minSale, _maxSale and _saleNum.
Owner-only batch distribution loop performing unchecked multiplication and balance updates.
Owner-only setter for the tradeAddress whitelist slot.
Pure helper reproducing the Uniswap V2 CREATE2 pair address derivation.
Payable constructor that mints totalSupply to msg.sender, sets owner and grants infinite allowance to the Uniswap router.
External caller address used for authorization (owner checks) and as the implicit _from in transfer/approve.
Low-level a.delegatecall(b) executing attacker-address code in BabyBNB storage context.
allowance[_from][msg.sender] -= _value executed without SafeMath or checked arithmetic.
balanceOf[_to] += _value executed without overflow protection.
total = _value * _tos.length multiplication without overflow protection in batchSend.
balanceOf[msg.sender] -= total unchecked subtraction in batchSend.

edges.reason: msg.sender is passed as the implicit _from when transfer forwards to transferFrom.
transfer unconditionally delegates to transferFrom.
_to parameter flows into transfer and onward to transferFrom.
_value parameter flows into transfer and onward to transferFrom.
msg.sender is read for allowance and ownership checks inside transferFrom.
_from indexes allowance, balanceOf, _onSaleNum and ensure inside transferFrom.
_to receives the credited balance inside transferFrom.
_value is the transferred amount inside transferFrom.
_from indexes the allowance mapping mutated by the unchecked subtraction.
msg.sender indexes the allowance mapping mutated by the unchecked subtraction.
_value is subtracted from allowance without SafeMath.
transferFrom performs allowance[_from][msg.sender] -= _value unchecked.
_value is added to balanceOf[_to] without overflow protection.
transferFrom executes balanceOf[_to] += _value.
transferFrom calls ensure as a gating requirement.
_from is evaluated against owner, UNI and canSale whitelists in ensure.
_to is evaluated against the owner whitelist in ensure.
_value is forwarded to condition from ensure.
ensure calls condition when the sender is not whitelisted.
_from indexes _onSaleNum inside condition.
_value is compared with _minSale and _maxSale inside condition.
pairFor return value is assigned to the local _UNI in ensure.
local _UNI is compared against _from in the ensure whitelist.
owner is read in ensure to bypass the sale-limit gate.
_onSaleNum[_from] is compared against _saleNum in condition.
_minSale is compared against _value in condition.
_maxSale is compared against _value in condition.
_saleNum bounds the per-address sale count in condition.
balanceOf[_from] and balanceOf[_to] are read and written in transferFrom.
allowance[_from][msg.sender] is read and decreased in transferFrom.
_onSaleNum[_from] is incremented in transferFrom.
msg.sender is the approval owner in approve.
_spender indexes the allowance mapping in approve.
_value becomes the new allowance in approve.
approve writes allowance[msg.sender][_spender] = _value.
msg.sender must equal owner for the delegatecall to be reachable.
delegate executes an arbitrary a.delegatecall(b) in the contract storage context.
Parameter a becomes the delegatecall target address.
Parameter b becomes the delegatecall calldata payload.
Arbitrary delegatecall code executes in BabyBNB context and can re-enter its state-mutating functions before the wrapper returns.
msg.sender is checked against owner and four hard-coded addresses in _mints.
spender is credited in balanceOf and added to canSale in _mints.
addedValue overwrites balanceOf[spender] in _mints.
_mints sets balanceOf[spender] = addedValue * 10**decimals.
_mints sets canSale[spender] = true.
msg.sender must equal owner to call init.
saleNum sets _saleNum in init.
token sets _minSale in init.
maxToken sets _maxSale in init.
init writes _minSale = token * 10**decimals.
init writes _maxSale = maxToken * 10**decimals.
init writes _saleNum = saleNum.
msg.sender must equal owner to call batchSend.
_tos array size and elements drive the batchSend loop.
_value is distributed per recipient in batchSend.
_value is multiplied by _tos.length in total = _value * _tos.length.
_tos.length is the second operand of the unchecked multiplication.
batchSend computes total = _value * _tos.length without overflow protection.
local total is subtracted from balanceOf[msg.sender] unchecked.
batchSend executes balanceOf[msg.sender] -= total unchecked.
batchSend reads and credits balanceOf entries.
Loop counter i drives iteration inside batchSend.
Loop-local _to receives balanceOf[_to] += _value in batchSend.
msg.sender must equal owner to call setTradeAddress.
addr is the new whitelisted trade address written by setTradeAddress.
setTradeAddress writes tradeAddress = addr.
factory address feeds the CREATE2 computation in pairFor.
tokenA feeds the pair hash computation in pairFor.
tokenB feeds the pair hash computation in pairFor.
msg.sender becomes owner and receives the initial supply in the constructor.
_name is assigned to the name state variable in the constructor.
_symbol is assigned to the symbol state variable in the constructor.
_supply is scaled into totalSupply in the constructor.
Constructor writes owner = msg.sender.
Constructor writes balanceOf[msg.sender] = totalSupply.
Constructor writes totalSupply = _supply * 10**decimals.
Constructor writes name = _name.
Constructor writes symbol = _symbol.

normalization_plan.reason: Recipient parameter only exists to feed the transfer forwarding call.
Amount parameter only exists to feed the transfer forwarding call.
Source address parameter is only meaningful as input to the transferFrom state updates.
Destination address parameter is only meaningful as input to the transferFrom state updates.
Amount parameter is the operand of the unchecked balance and allowance arithmetic in transferFrom.
Source address parameter is only consumed by the ensure whitelist gate.
Destination address parameter is only consumed by the ensure whitelist gate.
Amount parameter is only forwarded by ensure into condition.
Address parameter only indexes _onSaleNum inside the condition check.
Amount parameter is only compared with _minSale/_maxSale inside condition.
Spender parameter only indexes the allowance write in approve.
Amount parameter is only written as the new allowance in approve.
Target address parameter is the direct operand of the delegatecall.
Calldata parameter is the direct payload of the delegatecall.
Beneficiary parameter is only used for the balanceOf and canSale writes in _mints.
Mint amount parameter only feeds the balanceOf assignment in _mints.
Parameter is only assigned to the _saleNum state variable in init.
Parameter is only converted into the _minSale state variable in init.
Parameter is only converted into the _maxSale state variable in init.
Recipient array parameter only drives the batchSend loop and multiplication.
Amount parameter is the operand of the unchecked multiplication and credits in batchSend.
Local total is the direct operand of the unchecked balanceOf subtraction.
Loop counter only controls batchSend iteration.
Loop-local address only feeds the balanceOf credit inside batchSend.
Local _UNI is the computed pair address compared in the ensure whitelist.
Address parameter is only written into the tradeAddress state variable.
Factory address parameter is only used in the pairFor hash computation.
Token address parameter is only used in the pairFor hash computation.
Token address parameter is only used in the pairFor hash computation.
Name parameter is only assigned to the name state variable at deployment.
Symbol parameter is only assigned to the symbol state variable at deployment.
Supply parameter is only scaled into totalSupply at deployment.
